_doc: Per-texture overrides for weapon_masks.py (see its header): rules replace the default rule list, rects force a class inside a UV rectangle (0..1, top-left origin), default is the class for unmatched / transparent texels, values sets (G roughness, B metalness) per class. Keys are texture base names or globs.

melee_0._note: Combat Knife: the wrapped green grip (bottom right of the sheet) is rubber, not plastic; the blade and guard stay metal
